name: AS568-138 O-ring, silicone 70A, FDA grade
part_number: S70138 (The O-Ring Store, AS568-138 S70 FDA)

params.food_contact: FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 (supplier's formulation and test based claim, not a third-party certificate; statement of compliance on request)
params.water: -2 Shore A / +3 % volume after 70 h at 100 °C

params.note: Continuous in dry air; in hot water below 100 °C; reversion in steam above about 250 °F (121 °C). Static service only.

Static seal only: do not use it on a moving or rotating joint. It tears and cuts easily: deburr the groove, chamfer lead-ins, and do not drag it over sharp edges or threads. Never lubricate it with silicone grease, which swells it badly; use a compatible FDA-grade lubricant. Not compatible with silicone oils, ketones, concentrated acids and alkalis, chlorine, hydrocarbon fuels or superheated steam. Clean with mild soap and water or isopropyl alcohol. Static surface finish 16 to 32 µin Ra.

Face gland for the 0.103 in cross-section (host design): Minnesota Rubber gives a static gland depth of 0.082 in (2.08 mm, about 21 % squeeze) and a static axial groove width of 0.115 +0.005/-0 in (2.92 mm); Marco gives width 0.121 ± 0.003 in and depth 0.078 ± 0.003 in (about 24 % squeeze), corner radii 0.010 / 0.005 in, and a finish of 32 Ra max for fluids. Both sit inside the compound's 15-30 % static squeeze, but at nominal size both give about 89 % gland fill (ring section 5.39 mm² in 2.08 x 2.92 or 1.98 x 3.07 mm), above the compound's 65-85 % at temperature: at 2.08 mm depth a groove 3.05-3.45 mm wide gives 85-75 % (calculated from nominal values, not a source figure). Place the ring on the side of the groove away from the pressure: with pressure from inside (a liquid-filled bottle) the ring bears on the groove's outer wall, so the groove OD is about the ring OD (58.88 mm) and the ring is not stretched.

Smart bottle: one ring in a face groove on the cap floor, compressed onto the Nalgene 63 mm lip land (nalgene-32oz-wide-mouth.lip_seal) by the cap thread at the closing torque. Its Ø56.26 centre line lands on the bottle's assumed land (Ø55-Ø59.68); the ring's ID (53.64 mm) overhangs the assumed 1 mm inner chamfer. Both lip dimensions are assumptions on the bottle part, so check the footprint after measuring the bottle (OQ-B4).
